name: manual_da04cb
claim: Never put literal workstation paths ($HOME/...) in any tracked file — docs, scripts, memory, or config. Use relative paths (../../, ../filename), env vars ($OPENCLAW_ROOT, $REPO_ROOT), or ~ tilde. LINT-006 in repo_hygiene.py and CIDF Target Verification both enforce this as a pre-commit hard gate. The same rule applies to AI-generated memory content: use relative paths or strip the parent path tree; do NOT use <user> placeholder (it still exposes the directory structure).

decisions.notes: LINT-006 / CIDF anti-doxxing invariant: literal workstation paths in tracked files expose the developer's username and machine layout to anyone with repo access. Caught multiple times (2026-06-22 PR #123 dream-cycle content had /Users/lab and /Users/user). CI and pre-commit both block commits with violations.
